description: Wave 4c: client-side prediction with server reconciliation. World (snap=delta, inventory) + dev gateway + 2 bots with predicted movement (keys+look -> MoveInput; the world runs the same olife_proto:movement step; PlayerState -> compare/replay). Bot A (bot1) gets injected RTT 0 / 50 / 150 ms on the gateway (half each way); per phase: prediction error at ack (p50/p95/max), corrections per minute, snap magnitude, replay length. Sources of mispredictions: both bots break/place blocks (every 10 ticks) next to each other, and the world puts a 2-high wall in the cell 0.9 block ahead of every walking player every second (kept 0.5 s) (olife.disturb 10) — the client sees it one RTT late. Anti-cheat: a protocol client sends MoveInput 50/s (speed hack) — the world simulates <= 20/s of real time and drops the rest. End: bots halt, the movement state hash of every bot equals the world's (f32 pos/vel + flags), all inputs acked; per-tick replica hash consistency.
